name: f1_sky_backDouble
note: Round 11 flips: swing north up the avenue from 30 m, sky launch at 1.4 s with the backDouble program (tuck, held inverted pencil, tuck, layout flash, tuck, straddle, tuck, upright throne, reach: 720 deg back in 2.35 s), web re-pressed for the catch in the reach, then the swing chain continues.
